value: In the Horde telling, Bengor is found wounded in the Swamp of Sorrows. He reports that the dispatch was ambushed and the Warchief’s orders lost. His testimony brings the seeker to Trebor and gives the campaign a practical beginning: before the old soldier can speak of his shame, the missing command must be recovered. The chain does not turn the Alliance introduction into the same journey; it offers another way to reach the shared wound.
editorNote: This is a Horde-only quest branch. The visual scene is a broad Swamp of Sorrows setting, not a claimed exact roadside location.
